sections.heading: 릴리스/로드맵
sections.body:
**Cowork: Claude Code for the rest of your work**

Claude Cowork brings Claude Code's agentic task execution to non-coding knowledge work—folder-scoped file access, scheduled background tasks, parallel sub-agent

영향: Anthropic is productizing the same agent loop beyond terminals into recurring business workflows, signaling where Claude Code's architecture is headed for teams

> Claude Code is built for software engineering. Cowork is built for non-coding knowledge work. It uses the same agentic approach as Claude Code.

[원문 확인](https://claude.com/blog/cowork-research-preview)

sections.heading: 회귀·보안 신호
sections.body:
**v2.1.270**

Claude Code v2.1.270 fixes a regression from v2.1.269 where read-only git commands run via Bash started prompting for permission after a session had been runnin

영향: Teams running long Claude Code sessions rely on frictionless git status/log/diff checks; the bug broke routine read-only workflows and forced unnecessary approv

> Fixed read-only git commands in Bash unexpectedly asking for permission after a session had been running for a while (regression in 2.1.269)

[원문 확인](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.270)

**Claude Code is steganographically marking requests**

Reverse-engineering of Claude Code shows the client silently alters the system-prompt date line—Unicode apostrophe variants and date separators—based on ANTHROP

영향: A coding agent with shell and filesystem access hiding classification signals in invisible prompt punctuation undermines trust and makes privacy claims harder t

> Claude Code can silently change two things: The apostrophe in Today's and the date separator, from - to /. These are visually tiny changes you would never notice in most mono fonts.

[원문 확인](https://thereallo.dev/blog/claude-code-prompt-steganography)

**The Claude Code Source Leak: fake tools, frustration regexes, undercover mode**

Anthropic accidentally published a source map with the Claude Code npm package, exposing mechanisms including anti-distillation fake tool injection, undercover 

영향: The leak reveals how Anthropic enforces first-party client use, poisons distillation pipelines, and plans background agent features—directly relevant to anyone 

> When enabled, Claude Code sends anti_distillation: ['fake_tools'] in its API requests. There is NO force-OFF. This guards against model codename leaks.

[원문 확인](https://alex000kim.com/posts/2026-03-31-claude-code-source-leak/)

**Enterprise managed permissions for GitHub Copilot agent operations**

GitHub Copilot Business·Enterprise 관리자가 에이전트의 셸 명령, 파일 읽기·편집, 네트워크 도메인 작업을 중앙에서 차단·승인 필요·무승인 허용으로 세분화 제어할 수 있게 되었고, 이 정책은 사용자·워크스페이스 설정이나 자동 승인으로 약화할 수 없습니다.

영향: 에이전트가 파일·셸·외부 도메인에 접근하는 환경에서 보안·컴플라이언스 팀이 워크플로를 끄지 않고도 최소 권한 가드레일을 강제할 수 있어, 엔터프라이즈 도입 평가의 핵심 체크리스트가 됩니다.

> you can now centrally control which agent operations are blocked, require human approval, or can proceed without a prompt. Managed permissions cover shell commands, file reads and edits, and network d

[원문 확인](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-09-enterprise-managed-permissions-for-github-copilot-agent-operations)

**Enterprise-managed sandbox in Copilot for JetBrains**

GitHub Copilot JetBrains 플러그인에 엔터프라이즈 관리형 샌드박스 정책(퍼블릭 프리뷰)이 추가되었고, 크로스 파일 next-edit 이동, 채팅 전역 프로젝트 컨텍스트, 정책 진단, Copilot CLI `/ide` 연동 등이 함께 출시되었다.

영향: 조직이 샌드박스 파일시스템·네트워크·프록시·Keychain 접근을 중앙에서 강제할 수 있어, 에이전트가 로컬 도구를 쓰는 환경에서 보안 경계를 일관되게 적용하기 쉬워진다.

> Enterprise administrators can now centrally configure sandbox behavior for GitHub Copilot in JetBrains IDEs.

[원문 확인](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-08-enterprise-managed-sandbox-in-copilot-for-jetbrains)

**v2.1.266**

v2.1.265에서 `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY`만 설정해도 Cloud gateway 로그인을 강제하던 회귀를 되돌려, API 키·apiKeyHelper·커스텀 auth 헤더와 함께 쓰던 LLM gateway/프록시 구성이 다시 동작한다.

영향: 자체 AI gateway나 프록시로 Claude Code를 운영하는 팀은 설정 변경 없이 업그레이드만으로 세션이 복구되며, gateway 변수 동작 변경이 릴리스마다 인증 경로를 깨뜨릴 수 있다는 리스크가 드러난다.

> Fixed a 2.1.265 regression affecting LLM-gateway and proxy setups: the undocumented CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY environment variable... failed every request with "Not signed in to the Cloud gateway". The

[원문 확인](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.266)

**Claude Code's source code has been leaked via a map file in their NPM registry**

@anthropic-ai/claude-code v2.1.88 npm 패키지에 약 60MB 소스맵이 포함돼 약 512,000줄 TypeScript 소스가 공개 접근 가능해졌고, Anthropic은 패키지를 철회했다.

영향: 클라이언트 전체 구현·미출시 기능 플래그가 노출돼 경쟁사·보안 리뷰어가 에이전트 아키텍처·로드맵을 역분석할 수 있다.

> A release of the @anthropic-ai/claude-code npm package, version 2.1.88, shipped without excluding a source-map file — leaving around 512,000 lines of unobfuscated TypeScript publicly retrievable.

[원문 확인](https://itdoeswhatnow.com/m/2026-03-31-claude-code-source-code-accidentally-leaked-via-npm/)
